title: On the Hautus test for exact observability of normal semigroups
summary: Let $T$ be an exponentially stable strongly continuous semigroup on a Hilbert space $X$, $A$ its generator, $X_1$ the domain of $A$ with the norm $\|v\|_1 := \|Av\|$, and $C$ an admissible observation operator taking values in a Hilbert space $Y$. Russell and Weiss conjectured that if $(A,C)$ satisfies the infinite-dimensional Hautus test, then $(A,C)$ is exactly observable. After a counterexample was found their conjecture was modified to include the additional assumption that $T$ is similar to a contraction semigroup. We disprove this modified conjecture by constructing a counterexample in…
